scenarios.note: FR-EDIT-04: a branch picks its first output whose condition holds, and goes on by itself by the first connection of the output whose condition holds, without evaluating the conditions of the connections after it, of which one would report division_by_zero: the branch's on-exit, then that connection's on-traverse, without awaiting a choice
FR-EDIT-04: a branch picks its elseif when its if's condition does not hold
FR-EDIT-04: a branch picks its else when no other output's condition holds
FR-EDIT-04 AC1: at a branch whose conditions are all false and which has no else, the flow ends, a dead end: the branch's ready, then its on-exit, then the end
at a branch whose picked output no connection leaves, the flow ends, a dead end
at a branch whose picked output's connections' conditions are all false, the flow ends with no_choices
a cycle of branches goes round until a condition that its scripts change fails, each pass a visit of the branch
a cycle of branches whose conditions always hold ends once the flow has passed through 100 branches in one call: flow_loop, then a dead end at the branch, after its on-exit
a chain of branches passes through each, and the flow comes to rest at the element after them
start() at a branch, and goto() of one, pass through it as a connection to it does
